notes.title: Major update coming soon
notes.content: We are working hard on releasing a massive update that will make the game about 2-4 times as long as it was prior. Adding more weapons as well as more enemy's to deal with and hopefully enhancing the story. And best part for all of you. Its going to be a completely free update for anyone who has the game now or in the future! We hope you enjoy! We are hoping to release it in the next week or 2.

notes.title: Last Sighting has just released!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that Last Sighting has just released on steam as of November 15th!  This is our first game as Arachnis Games and it was made in 45 days by  only 2 devs! We have worked hard to bring you a survival horror game we hope you will enjoy. 

Be sure to treat Jeffery kind as he travels with you through the mystery of what's going on with your neighbor as you explore the darkness of night.

We would like to thank everyone who supported us and tested our games though out this these many of 14 hour days. 

Thanks to 

Austin A Smith (Austiago/Austino)

Mined (Mr D)

Jhonny ( The Kid)

From all of us at Arachnis games (yes the 2 of us) Thank you all and enjoy!

Devs:

Batnobiex (Conner White)

Pitchwhitedragon (Cody Davis)

notes.title: Last Sighting Has come to steam!
notes.content: We are excited to announce that we are finally here! Last Sighting our first horror game. Will be releasing on Steam in November. Prepare to travel with a dog. See some events that are not of this world. And see some chickens? all of that coming to you soon!
